requirements.requirement_text: The employer shall establish an energy control program consisting of procedures, employee training, and periodic inspections to ensure isolation before servicing or maintenance where unexpected energization, start-up, or release of stored energy could occur and cause injury.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: The employer shall establish a program consisting of energy control procedures, employee training and periodic inspections to ensure that before any employee performs any servicing or maintenance on a machine or equipment where the unexpected energizing, startup or release of stored energy could occur and cause injury, the machine or equipment shall be isolated from the energy source and rendered inoperative.

requirements.requirement_text: Procedures shall be developed, documented, and utilized for the control of potentially hazardous energy when employees are engaged in covered servicing or maintenance activities.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Procedures shall be developed, documented and utilized for the control of potentially hazardous energy when employees are engaged in the activities covered by this section.

requirements.requirement_text: The energy control procedures shall clearly and specifically outline the scope, purpose, authorization, rules, and techniques to be utilized for the control of hazardous energy, and the means to enforce compliance.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: The procedures shall clearly and specifically outline the scope, purpose, authorization, rules, and techniques to be utilized for the control of hazardous energy, and the means to enforce compliance.

requirements.requirement_text: The employer shall provide locks, tags, chains, wedges, key blocks, adapter pins, self-locking fasteners, or other hardware for isolating, securing, or blocking machines from energy sources.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Locks, tags, chains, wedges, key blocks, adapter pins, self-locking fasteners, or other hardware shall be provided by the employer for isolating, securing or blocking of machines or equipment from energy sources.

requirements.requirement_text: The employer shall conduct a periodic inspection of the energy control procedure at least annually to ensure that the procedure and the requirements of this standard are being followed.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: The employer shall conduct a periodic inspection of the energy control procedure at least annually to ensure that the procedure and the requirements of this standard are being followed.

requirements.requirement_text: The employer shall provide training to ensure that the purpose and function of the energy control program are understood by employees and that employees acquire the knowledge and skills required for safe application, usage, and removal of energy controls.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: The employer shall provide training to ensure that the purpose and function of the energy control program are understood by employees and that the knowledge and skills required for the safe application, usage, and removal of the energy controls are acquired by employees.

requirements.requirement_text: Retraining shall be provided for all authorized and affected employees whenever there is a change in job assignments, machines, equipment, or processes that present a new hazard, or a change in energy control procedures.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Retraining shall be provided for all authorized and affected employees whenever there is a change in their job assignments, a change in machines, equipment or processes that present a new hazard, or when there is a change in the energy control procedures.

workflow_trigger_details.condition: Retraining is required after job reassignment, a machine/equipment/process change presenting a new hazard, or a change in energy-control procedures.

requirements.requirement_text: All energy isolating devices needed to control the energy to the machine or equipment shall be physically located and operated in such a manner as to isolate the machine or equipment from energy sources.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: All energy isolating devices that are needed to control the energy to the machine or equipment shall be physically located and operated in such a manner as to isolate the machine or equipment from the energy source(s).

requirements.requirement_text: Following the application of lockout or tagout devices to energy isolating devices, all potentially hazardous stored or residual energy shall be relieved, disconnected, restrained, and otherwise rendered safe.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Following the application of lockout or tagout devices to energy isolating devices, all potentially hazardous stored or residual energy shall be relieved, disconnected, restrained, and otherwise rendered safe.

requirements.requirement_text: Each lockout or tagout device shall be removed by the employee who applied it, except that when that employee is unavailable, removal may occur under employer direction using documented specific procedures and training that provide equivalent safety.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Each lockout or tagout device shall be removed from each energy isolating device by the employee who applied the device.

workflow_trigger_details.condition: Removal by another person is permitted only when the applying employee is unavailable and the documented exception procedure is followed.

requirements.requirement_text: Whenever outside servicing personnel are engaged in covered activities, the on-site employer and the outside employer shall inform each other of their respective lockout or tagout procedures.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Whenever outside servicing personnel are to be engaged in activities covered by the scope and application of this standard, the on-site employer and the outside employer shall inform each other of their respective lockout or tagout procedures.

requirements.requirement_text: The employer shall certify that the periodic inspection of the energy control procedure has been performed. The certification shall identify the machine or equipment on which the energy control procedure was being utilized, the date of the inspection, the employees included in the inspection, and the person performing the inspection.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: The employer shall certify that the periodic inspections have been performed. The certification shall identify the machine or equipment on which the energy control procedure was being utilized, the date of the inspection, the employees included in the inspection, and the person performing the inspection.

requirements.requirement_text: The employer shall certify that employee training on the energy control program has been accomplished and is being kept up to date. The certification shall contain each employee's name and the dates of training.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: The employer shall certify that employee training has been accomplished and is being kept up to date. The certification shall contain each employee's name and dates of training.

requirements.requirement_text: Prior to starting work on machines or equipment that have been locked out or tagged out, the authorized employee shall verify that isolation and deenergization of the machine or equipment have been accomplished.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Prior to starting work on machines or equipment that have been locked out or tagged out, the authorized employee shall verify that isolation and deenergization of the machine or equipment have been accomplished.

requirements.requirement_text: Affected employees shall be notified by the employer or authorized employee of the application and removal of lockout or tagout devices; notification shall be given before the controls are applied and after they are removed from the machine or equipment.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Affected employees shall be notified by the employer or authorized employee of the application and removal of lockout devices or tagout devices. Notification shall be given before the controls are applied, and after they are removed from the machine or equipment.

requirements.requirement_text: Before lockout or tagout devices are removed and energy is restored, the work area shall be inspected to ensure nonessential items have been removed and machine or equipment components are operationally intact; all employees shall be checked to ensure they have been safely positioned or removed; and once the devices are removed, affected employees shall be notified before the machine or equipment is started.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: The work area shall be inspected to ensure that nonessential items have been removed and to ensure that machine or equipment components are operationally intact. [(e)(2)(i)] The work area shall be checked to ensure that all employees have been safely positioned or removed. [(e)(2)(ii)] After lockout or tagout devices have been removed and before a machine or equipment is started, affected employees shall be notified that the lockout or tagout device(s) have been removed.

requirements.requirement_text: Lockout or tagout shall be performed only by the authorized employees who are performing the servicing or maintenance.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Lockout or tagout shall be performed only by the authorized employees who are performing the servicing or maintenance.

requirements.requirement_text: Specific procedures shall be utilized during shift or personnel changes to ensure the continuity of lockout or tagout protection, including provision for the orderly transfer of lockout or tagout device protection between off-going and oncoming employees, to minimize exposure to hazards from unexpected energization, start-up, or release of stored energy.

provenance.source_text_excerpt: Specific procedures shall be utilized during shift or personnel changes to ensure the continuity of lockout or tagout protection, including provision for the orderly transfer of lockout or tagout device protection between off-going and oncoming employees, to minimize exposure to hazards from the unexpected energization or start-up of the machine or equipment, or the release of stored energy.
